Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 25 September 2026 25 September 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 21-Sep-2026 290,000 257.4781 255.6000 258.6000 22-Sep-2026 265,267 254.1688 252.6000 256.0000 23-Sep-2026 278,593 254.1666 252.4000 255.2000 24-Sep-2026 300,000 253.4646 252.0000 254.6000 25-Sep-2026 270,673 252.9692 251.8000 254.2000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 964,652,153 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 38,093,861 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 25 September 2026 is 964,652,153 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 9,643,396 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
